scripts.dev: concurrently --names "node,client,engine" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run engine"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:go: concurrently --names "go,node,client,engine" "cd server-go && go run ./cmd/api" "PORT=5001 npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run engine"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build:go: cd server-go && mkdir -p bin && go build -o bin/codeflow-api ./cmd/api
scripts.docker:up: CLIENT_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8080 GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=http://localhost:8080/auth/github/callback docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.production.yml up -d --wait
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
